sections_enrollment.name: sections_enrollment
sections_enrollment.body_sql:
SELECT 
  SECTION_ID AS section,
  TERM_CODE AS term_code,
  GROUP_CONCAT(IS_LECTURE_SECTION, IS_LAB_SECTION, IS_RECITATION_SECTION, IS_DESIGN_SECTION) AS formats,
  SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_student_count
FROM subject_offered
GROUP BY SECTION_ID, TERM_CODE
sections_enrollment.description: aggregates enrollment counts and format flags for each course section

building_accommodation.name: building_accommodation
building_accommodation.body_sql:
SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME, SUM(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS accommodation_capacity
FROM buildings b
JOIN space_detail sd ON b.BUILDING_KEY = sd.BUILDING_KEY
GROUP BY b.BUILDING_KEY, b.BUILDING_NAME
building_accommodation.description: aggregates the total student accommodation capacity per building

ranked_buildings.name: ranked_buildings
ranked_buildings.body_sql:
SELECT 
  building_name,
  accommodation_capacity,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY accommodation_capacity DESC) AS rank
FROM building_accommodation
ranked_buildings.description: assigns a descending rank to each building based on its accommodation capacity

building_records.name: building_records
building_records.body_sql:
SELECT b.BUILDING_NAME AS building_name, f.FLOOR AS floor_number
FROM buildings b
JOIN fac_floor f ON b.BUILDING_KEY = f.BUILDING_KEY
building_records.description: All buildings with their name and floor number.

building_floor_rank.name: building_floor_rank
building_floor_rank.body_sql:
SELECT b.`BUILDING_NAME` AS building_name, f.`FLOOR` AS floor_number, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY f.`FLOOR` DESC) AS floor_rank
FROM fac_floor f
JOIN buildings b ON f.`BUILDING_KEY` = b.`BUILDING_KEY`
building_floor_rank.description: Assigns a descending rank to each building based on its floor number.

iap_subject_records.name: iap_subject_records
iap_subject_records.body_sql:
SELECT 
  iap.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME AS category_name,
  SUBSTRING(so.TERM_CODE, 1, 4) AS academic_year,
  id.FEE AS fee,
  so.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER AS enrollment
FROM subject_offered so
JOIN iap_subject_detail id ON so.SUBJECT_KEY = id.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY
JOIN iap_subject_category iap ON id.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = iap.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
iap_subject_records.description: base IAP subject records containing category, academic year, fee, and enrollment values

category_year_stats.name: category_year_stats
category_year_stats.body_sql:
SELECT 
    category_name,
    academic_year,
    SUM(fee) AS total_fee_collected,
    COUNT(*) AS total_iap_subjects,
    MIN(enrollment) AS minimum_enrollment,
    MAX(enrollment) AS maximum_enrollment
FROM iap_subject_records
GROUP BY category_name, academic_year
category_year_stats.description: aggregated metrics per IAP category and academic year, computing total fees, subject counts, and enrollment min/max

term_iap_metrics.name: term_iap_metrics
term_iap_metrics.body_sql:
SELECT
  at.TERM_CODE AS term_code,
  at.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS term_description,
  COALESCE(s.total_sessions, 0) AS total_iap_sessions,
  COALESCE(f.total_fee, 0) AS total_fee_collected,
  f.min_enrollment AS min_enrollment,
  f.max_enrollment AS max_enrollment
FROM academic_terms at
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT TERM_CODE, COUNT(*) AS total_sessions
  FROM subject_iap_schedule
  GROUP BY TERM_CODE
) s ON at.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT TERM_CODE, SUM(FEE) AS total_fee, MIN(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS min_enrollment, MAX(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS max_enrollment
  FROM iap_subject_detail
  GROUP BY TERM_CODE
) f ON at.TERM_CODE = f.TERM_CODE
term_iap_metrics.description: Computes session counts, fee totals, and enrollment ranges per term.
